request.notes: All four filters are optional (string or null, default null; additionalProperties false) and each one given is an exact '=' match, ANDed. Lens sends only the filters it has: the edge-table snapshot's ONE unfiltered call sends {} and receives the WHOLE edges table — there is no limit, offset, order or total, so the row order is SQLite's and means nothing. The 'filtered' variant is the read a table over [knowledge].graph_edge_table_max_edges is still served by. from_id / to_id (never type or namespace) are resolved leniently: an exact note id passes, a value under 6 characters or matching no note filters literally (endpoints need not be notes), a unique >= 6-char prefix of a note id resolves to that id, and an AMBIGUOUS one is refused with ambiguous_id_prefix (at most 5 {id, title} candidates). Lens never sends a prefix. Direction facts, from the sources cited: contradicts, analogy_to and related_to are stored symmetric (from_id <= to_id); supports, refines, is_example_of and depends_on are directed by the adjudicator's verdict; derived_from runs derived -> source. type is unvalidated, so other values occur (live 2026-10-05: assesses, summarizes).
